name: averlo-next
description: Repository workflows for creating, publishing, building, reviewing, and backporting Averlo Next application patterns.

interface.longDescription: Averlo Next packages workflows for initializing independent projects, publishing private GitLab repositories to Vercel, shaping entity UI, enforcing application surfaces and Storybook-backed public UI, deterministic Figma exports, and reviewed story backports.
defaultPrompt: Create and verify a new Averlo project
Publish an Averlo project to its configured private GitLab and Vercel targets
Audit this entity UI against Averlo Next
Backport approved Storybook stories into the Averlo template
